entries.title: Fallen Aces

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.

primary.version: Steam Early Access current PC build
primary.why: The Windows PC Steam release is the only sourced release route and is therefore both the highest-fidelity and most complete playable version currently documented.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Fallen Aces on Steam for Windows PC and keep it updated for the latest Early Access chapter/content build.

entries.remaster_caveats: This is an Early Access release, so content and technical behavior may change before 1.0.
